banner.title: TABLE 55 (BARDED WARHORSE BASE MOVEMENT RATES), printed capture p. 98 - the OA barding round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture (the settling authority), with the compressed-print capture giving a second independent read of the page - the 4-row grid cross-checked cell-by-cell between the two passes; the movement pairs agree in both passes - zero numeric contested cells. The artifacts are glyph and word class: the movement prints with the prime glyph (feet) in the print capture against the compressed double-prime (the R645 class, the feet read stands, the numeric columns strip the unit) and the light-horse metal-scale pair prints 15 with a stray space before the prime in the print pass (an OCR cell artifact, the value stands). The note under the table reads Tumber before the slash in BOTH passes - an OCR slip for The number, noted; the note doctrine pins as two bools: the number before the slash is for full barding, the number after for half-barding, and an X indicates the barding is heavier than the horse can bear. The light-horse chain full cell prints X and the elephant metal and chain cells print blank - both classes pin as -99, distinguished by the column comments; the elephant padded cell prints a lone 12 without the full/half slash - the T50 lone-number lo=hi convention carries it. The warhorse names ride the column comments per the T48 doctrine. The barding prose box (the AC-factor and weight paragraph) and the misc equipment prose box stay open
banner.sentinel: the gap census after this round: 97 closed, 138 open - the Table 55 box flips (census 568 -> 569); NEXT - R647: the Miscellaneous Equipment Descriptions prose box (capture p. 98), the grenades prose, prefix dhh (verify free), audit "R647 OA misc equipment audit", include after rules/oabarding.h - the barding prose box stays open beside it
